## Challenge submission

**Challenge:** <!-- e.g. 01 - CSS Bug Hunt -->

**What was wrong**
<!-- The actual cause, not just the symptom. -->

**What I changed**
<!-- And why this fix rather than another. -->

**How I checked it works**
<!-- What you actually did: which browser, which screen width, what you saw. -->

**Anything you're unsure about**
<!-- Optional, and never held against you. Flagging a real uncertainty is a good sign. -->

- [ ] I did only the challenge I was assigned
- [ ] My diff contains no unrelated changes (no reformatting, no stray files)
- [ ] I opened the page in a browser and confirmed the fix

> Heads up: challenge PRs are reviewed and then **closed, not merged** — the
> challenges have to stay broken for the next person. That's the expected
> outcome, not a rejection. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Contribution

<!-- For new challenges, site fixes, or docs. -->

**What this changes and why**

**New challenge?** Then also:

- [ ] Folder is self-contained, no dependencies, no build step
- [ ] README follows the format in `challenges/_TEMPLATE/README.md`
- [ ] README describes the symptom, not the fix
- [ ] Exactly one defect
- [ ] Row added to the table in the root README, with matching difficulty
- [ ] Verified in a browser: symptom is visible, intended fix resolves it
